_about: creaite settings. Single source of truth for tunable values. Edited in the dashboard's Settings tab (saved instantly, with a backup and a log entry) or with cx-edit. Read by CLAUDE.md rules, skills and scripts.

vip._about: VIPs (BL-99): people marked VIP in the people register. Anything they send is alerted at the top of Today. check_minutes: how often the live server looks for VIP mail, Teams and invites while it runs (nothing is seen while creaite is closed; the next start catches up). notify: a browser notification as well as the Today block.

archive._about: Archiving (BL-10, BL-03). after_months: closed or cancelled actions and RAID items, and done or dropped promises, are archived (flagged, still searchable, undoable) this many months after closing, once a day; 0 turns a kind off. Decisions, milestones and open items never are. reports_after_months: weekly and client reports, minutes and Steerco one-pagers older than this (by the date in their name) are offered once a month in Settings › Health, to move into the engagement's own _Archive.

promises.note: BL-125 A: the sweep proposes promises only when from_sweep is true; promises from minutes and added by hand are unaffected

people.note: renames and merges are applied to items and logged; not stored here

excel.export: immediate on every apply; pauses only while unimported workbook edits exist

warnings._about: Early warnings (BL-51): flags worked out at build time from data already held; never stored as tracker rows. Switch each off or set its threshold in Settings.

prep._about: Meeting prep (BL-49): the project chosen for each meeting series whose match was unsure; set from a meeting's Prep brief.

inbox._about: The Inbox's Meetings (BL-42): the saved calendar goes back to Monday of this week ("monday"), or a number of days.

locations._about: Where the projects live (BL-85). Empty projects_root: the vault's own projects/ folder. Otherwise the engagement folders and the portfolio folder live there (the company OneDrive; stored with ~ for the home folder). Folder paths are relative to each engagement folder. The database, staging, backups, history, search index, git and the engine always stay in the local vault.

help._about: Help (BL-84): start_seen is false until the dashboard has shown Help › Start here once, on its first visit; the dashboard then sets it to true.

drafting._about: AI drafts (BL-218 to BL-227): each feature on (true) or off. A draft is a suggestion, never a write: it lands in an unsaved field, a pending proposal or a dialog. Settings › General › AI drafts.

reports._about: v2.1.0 (BL-335, BL-338): reports and minutes in creaite's own format; their HTML, Word and PDF exports.
